widgets_values: Photoreal street video with a flat 2D character composited into it, one continuous take, shopfront signage soft-focus and illegible. A very tall cartoon workman in an orange beanie leans over a busy street, one thick-outlined hand resting on the roof of a passing white truck, his cartoon sleeve creasing; two small cartoon cone-shaped street characters stride across the asphalt among real motorbikes, their felt-tip outlines flat and unshaded while everything behind them stays photographic and keeps moving. 0-2s: low camera at road level, the giant hand settles on the truck roof, the truck dipping nothing. 2-3.5s: camera tilts up the giant arm to his face looking down, curious. 3.5-5s: tilt back down, the two cone characters walk out of frame. Audio: real traffic, horns, engine idle, one cartoon boing when the hand lands.
